Name: Run Code Execution Agent
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Launches a Google ADK Agent that utilizes Gemini's native, built-in Python execution tool. Executes Python code natively within Google's backend API lifecycle to handle data manipulation, mathematical operations, and log formatting without requiring a dedicated sandbox container.

Parameters.DefaultValue: Calculate the first 10 elements of the fibonacci sequence
Parameters.Description: The analytical task or computation instruction for the code execution agent.
Thinking budget (token count) for model reasoning (e.g. 1024).
Whether to equip the agent with persistent long-term memory via Vertex AI Memory Bank.
Optional session identifier to scope memory context. Defaults to active case ID (case_<CaseId>).
